title: File Upload & Analysis

body.text: You can drag many file types into the chat:
PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, and code
— ChatGPT reads the content and can summarize, answer questions, compare, or extract the info you need.

example: "Read this lease agreement PDF and summarize the key terms, penalties, and things to watch for before signing"

title: Techniques for working with files

body.text: You can upload several files at once to
